name: 06114 · Hartford, CT
findings: ZIP 06114 (Hartford) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06114 (Hartford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06114 (Hartford) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
